text:
emma: Quick heads-up — preflight prompt-eval for v0.24.0 (runtime + prompt-set) shows a conversational-followup suite delta = +1.9% vs baseline. Gate block threshold is 2.0%, alert threshold is 1.5%.

sanjay: Raw report and per-prompt diffs: https://intra/reports/3632109876 . Sample N=6.1k, stratified by product surface. 95% bootstrap upper=2.6%.

release-bot: Preflight status: PROMOTION_HELD (prompt-eval delta=1.9%). Manual action required: signoff, pin, staggered rollout, or override.

maya: Can you paste the top failing prompt ids and whether failures are multi-turn only?

sanjay: Top failures are mostly multi-turn disambiguation / clarification followups; single-turn generation unaffected. Failing prompt ids: pf-3741, pf-3780, pf-3912 (linked in the report).

caroline: QA did a quick 60-sample sweep this morning — ~9 notable regressions (awkward followup phrasing). Not safety-critical but could affect UX in longer dialogs. I can run 200 samples and annotate in ~40min.

emma: I'm leaning toward a low-risk staged rollout rather than a full block. Proposal: start a staged canary at 10% traffic for 1 hour, with a rolling increase to 100% over 3 hours if followup delta stays <=2.5%. If it crosses 2.5% within any 60m window, auto-fallback to previous prompt-set. This gives us population-level data without a hard rollback. Thoughts?

sanjay: I like the auto-fallback guardrail. We get telemetry and avoid a blanket rollback. Also will prepare a small hotfix branch if patterns look systemic.

maya: Can Console create a staged rollout with an automated metric-triggered rollback? I can configure rollout policy and monitoring hooks. ETA 10m.

caroline: If we do staged rollout, I'll prioritize the 200-sample sweep and post annotated edge cases immediately. If we see explanation-level failures, we'll escalate.

deploy-bot: Staged rollout request received: create rollout "v0.24.0-staged-3632109876". Initial traffic: 10% canary -> linear ramp to 100% over 3h. Auto-fallback condition: followup_delta > 2.5% over any 60m window -> rollback to prompt-set=20260301-stable. No downtime expected. Change ticket: RT-3632109876.

emma: Add a Known Issues line in the release notes: "Potential conversational-followup variance observed; staged rollout with auto-fallback enabled. Monitoring and QA sweep in progress." Also set an alert to page on followup_delta > 2.5%.

sanjay: I'll add an extra targeted preflight check in CI for the followup prompt family so we catch similar regressions earlier. PR will reference this thread.

maya: Rollout policy applied in Console and monitoring hook attached. Visible in UI under Releases -> v0.24.0.

caroline: Uploaded 200-sample annotated sheet to evals: https://intra/evals/3632109876/qa-sheet and marked 12 borderline examples. QA signoff pending review of annotated cases.

emma: Any objections to proceeding with staged rollout under these controls?

maya: +1

sanjay: +1 (will watch metrics and post summaries)

caroline: +1 after QA annotations reviewed (annotated and signed in dashboard)

release-bot: Promotion permitted with conditions: staged rollout with auto-fallback and QA signoff required. Scheduling promotion now for v0.24.0. Change window: 3h ramp with 60m auto-fallback checks.

emma: Thanks — I'll finalize release notes and create the followup dashboard for 24h checks. If the hotfix PR looks promising, we'll accelerate unpin/rollback decisions as needed.

sanjay: PR and targeted tests will be posted here when ready; planning a post-deployment smoke in 30m.

caroline: QA sweep complete and annotated; no new blockers. Marked signoff in dashboard.

emma: Closing loop: release proceeding with staged rollout + auto-fallback guardrail. Will monitor and update this thread with any rollback or hotfix decisions.
